method: Manual structured comparison of official public documentation; no live answer experiment
selection: Purposive: four surfaces named or relevant to the requested GEO guide; not a market sample

records.surface: Google Search AI Overviews and AI Mode
records.access: Google Search eligibility plus Search generative AI inclusion control
records.training_separation: Search inclusion control is distinct from training controls
records.link_interpretation: Supporting links within generated search features
records.measurement: Documented generative AI impressions report; property and URL aggregation differ
records.inference_limit: Eligibility does not guarantee a supporting link; impressions are not conversions

records.access: OAI-SearchBot and documented IP access; separate user-requested fetcher
records.training_separation: GPTBot and OAI-SearchBot permissions are independent
records.link_interpretation: Search-answer sources differ from navigational links
records.measurement: Publisher FAQ documents referral UTM parameter; retain prompt-level answer observations separately
records.inference_limit: Crawler access or a referral is not a census of answer appearances

records.access: Google-Extended documentation covers certain grounding uses; do not substitute Google Search rules
records.training_separation: Google-Extended covers training and specified grounding uses, not a universal independent search-only switch
records.link_interpretation: Sources, related content and double-check links must be distinguished
records.measurement: Manually classify visible link type and preserve answer context
records.inference_limit: A double-check corroboration link need not be a source used to generate the answer

records.access: PerplexityBot search crawling and Perplexity-User user-requested fetching are documented separately
records.training_separation: These documented agents are not described as foundation-model training crawlers
records.link_interpretation: User-triggered retrieval may support a linked answer
records.measurement: Separate crawler logs from observations of actual answer sources
records.inference_limit: A bot request does not establish whether a human saw or clicked a citation

limitations: No ranking factors or causal uplift measured
No vendor account access or live UI test performed
Analyst-authored interpretation fields are labelled as such in the methodology
Google older and newer guidance differed; current dedicated feature documentation was prioritised
